reviews.name: Aarav Sharma
reviews.review: The Besan & Curd Tikka Paneer is unmatched! Soft, spicy, besan marinated without any heavy mayo. Truly living up to the health & taste motto! The 4-circle ambiance and retro vibes make it our family's favorite spot.

reviews.name: Priya Verma & Friends
reviews.review: We booked Chandni Chowk Cheese Café for our monthly Kitty Party and the setup was mind-blowing! The customized setups, fun photo moments, and live snacks were top tier. And the Fruit Beer was a huge hit!

reviews.name: Kunal Mehra
reviews.review: The Burning Drinks are mind-blowing! Watching them infuse the Blue Ignite with smoky apple wood right in front of us is a true spectacle. Best handcrafted smoky mocktails in Haryana!

reviews.name: Simran Kaur
reviews.review: Booked their catering for my sister's 18th birthday house party. They brought the entire setup, hot live snacks, kathi rolls, and tandoori momos. Zero hassle for us, total luxury for our guests!

reviews.name: Rohan & Tina
reviews.dish: The Cafe Classic Pizza & Long Fries
reviews.review: The Cafe Classic Pizza with marinated paneer and crisp veggies is better than any big international chain. Plus the peri-peri long fries are insanely crunchy!

faqs.a: Yes! Chandni Chowk Cheese Café is strictly 100% vegetarian. All our rolls, burgers, pizzas, and tandoori snacks are made with fresh dairy paneer, hand-picked farm veggies, and zero mayonnaise.

The Burning Drinks are our signature handcrafted smoky mocktails (Blue Ignite, Red Flame, Golden Ashes) infused live with natural wood smoke flavor of your choice: Cherry (Sweet & Fruity), Oak (Bold & Classic), Apple (Crisp & Light), or Peach (Sweet & Blossomy).

faqs.q: How do we book catering for Birthdays, House Parties, or Kitty Parties?
faqs.a: You can select your event type in our Catering section, call us directly at 9350-990071 / 8901-484042, or scan our Instagram QR code to DM us. We provide full on-site setups, live counters, and customized menu platters.

faqs.q: Where is the café located and can we dine in?
faqs.a: We are located at Chandni Chowk, Bhatia Building, Near ICICI Bank, Yamunanagar. Scan our Location QR code below to navigate directly on Google Maps. We have a cozy, bohemian-retro dine-in space with full music and neon vibes!

faqs.q: Can you customize menus for spice levels or special dietary needs?
faqs.a: Yes, absolutely! We gladly accommodate mild, medium, or fiery spice requests, as well as Jain-friendly (no onion, no garlic) preparation upon advance notice.
